stem: Meera watches the Sun from her balcony in Jaipur every morning. She notices that the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west each day. Why does the Sun appear to move from east to west across the sky?

options.text: The Sun revolves around Earth once every 24 hours
Earth rotates on its own axis from west to east
Earth revolves around the Sun once every year
The Moon pulls the Sun across the sky

teacher.key_rationale: The Sun's apparent daily east-to-west motion is caused by Earth's rotation on its axis from west to east in about 24 hours, so B is correct. A reverses the relationship (Sun orbiting Earth), C confuses revolution with rotation, and D introduces an irrelevant cause.
